nodes.label: SAG Tech applied bootcamp: building early technical products (MVP) with Claude — برنامج تدريبي تطبيقي لبناء المنتجات الرقمية، من الفكرة إلى منتج منشور
nodes.rationale: Stated purpose: a complete applied journey converting an idea into a usable, testable and publishable technical product — 'من الفكرة إلى منتج منشور'.

nodes.label: SAG Tech (شركة ساج التقنية) — training provider, info@sag.sa / www.sag.sa / 0530097954
Schedule: 10 training days x 4 hours = 40 training hours, 2 weeks, Sunday–Thursday (10 أيام تدريبية، 4 ساعات يوميًا، 40 ساعة، أسبوعان، من الأحد إلى الخميس)
nodes.rationale: Two training weeks are chosen so the journey is gradual: it starts with planning and ends with a published, testable product.

nodes.label: Core tooling: Claude + Claude Code — AI leads analysis, design, implementation, testing and deployment (يقود الذكاء الاصطناعي عملية التحليل والتصميم والتنفيذ والاختبار والنشر)
nodes.rationale: Division of labour mandated by the brochure: the AI executes while the trainee reviews the outputs and tries them out practically (بينما يراجع المتدرب المخرجات ويجربها عمليًا) — this is why no deep programming experience is required.

nodes.label: Programme goal: give the trainee a clear methodology + practical tools to build a complete prototype, instead of stopping at an idea or an unusable design (الغاية)
nodes.rationale: Explicitly contrasted with 'الاكتفاء بفكرة أو تصميم غير قابل للاستخدام' — the deliverable must be usable, not merely conceptual.

nodes.label: No deep programming experience required (دون الحاجة إلى خبرة برمجية عميقة / لا يُشترط امتلاك خبرة برمجية تطبيقية)
Prerequisite knowledge: basic conceptual grasp of domain, hosting, Front-End, Back-End and API — as general concepts, not as programming practice (المعرفة المسبقة)
Audience 1: entrepreneurs wanting to execute specific technical products (رواد ورائدات الأعمال)
Audience 2: IT and computer-science students and graduates (طلاب وخريجو تخصصات تقنية المعلومات وعلوم الحاسب)
Audience 3: beginner and intermediate programmers/developers (المبرمجون والمطورون في المستوى المبتدئ والمتوسط)
Audience 4: product and user-experience designers (مصممو المنتجات وتجربة المستخدم)
Audience 5: innovation and digital-transformation staff, product and technical project managers (موظفو الابتكار والتحول الرقمي ومديرو المنتجات والمشاريع التقنية)
Audience 6: people interested in building digital products using Claude (المهتمون ببناء المنتجات الرقمية باستخدام Claude)
Audience 7: business owners wanting prototypes of digital products (أصحاب المنشآت الراغبون في بناء نماذج أولية لمنتجات رقمية)
Build phase A — planning & design, stages 1–6 (مراحل بناء المنتج: التخطيط والتصميم)
nodes.rationale: A gradual track that guarantees the idea, the user and the requirements are clear BEFORE moving to technical implementation (مسار متدرج يضمن وضوح الفكرة والمستخدم والمتطلبات قبل الانتقال إلى التنفيذ التقني).

nodes.label: Build phase B — implementation & launch, stages 7–12 (مراحل بناء المنتج: التنفيذ والإطلاق)
nodes.rationale: Entered only after planning and design are approved (بعد اعتماد التخطيط والتصميم), then build → connect → test → publish to a live link.

nodes.label: Working principle: every stage produces a clear deliverable that is reviewed and approved before the next stage builds on it (كل مرحلة تنتج مخرجًا واضحًا يُراجع ويُعتمد قبل البناء عليها في المرحلة التالية)
nodes.rationale: Stage-gating is the mechanism that keeps an AI-driven build reviewable by a non-programmer trainee.

nodes.label: Stage 1: define the idea and the MVP concept — frame the problem and the core value of the first version (تعريف الفكرة ومفهوم MVP)
Stage 2: users and stakeholders — identify benefiting/affected parties and each party's needs (المستخدمون وأصحاب المصلحة)
Stage 3: scope of the first version — pick core features, exclude what is not needed for the first test (نطاق النسخة الأولية)
Stage 4: system requirements — requirements, user stories and acceptance criteria (متطلبات النظام)
Stage 5: user journey — draw usage steps and the core workflow diagrams (رحلة المستخدم ومخططات سير العمل)
Stage 6: design — design the screens and set up a consistent, applicable design system (التصميم ونظام تصميم متسق)
Stage 7: data model (ERD) — design the tables and relations supporting product functions (نموذج البيانات)
Stage 8: implementation — build the product and connect it to the database and external services (تنفيذ المنتج)
Stage 9: login and permissions — set up sign-in, roles and access control by permission (الدخول والصلاحيات)
Stage 10: testing and security — test functions, error cases, and review constraints and permissions (الاختبار والأمان)
Stage 11: version management — save the project and document updates/releases on GitHub (إدارة الإصدارات)
Stage 12: deployment and final demo — publish the product on a live link and prepare it for demo and trial (النشر والعرض النهائي)
Track end point: a complete usable, testable MVP, saved on GitHub and published via Vercel (النقطة النهائية للمسار)
Skill: manage sessions, context, credit and Tokens efficiently (إدارة الجلسات والسياق والرصيد ووحدات Tokens بكفاءة)
Skill: use Rules / Skills / MCP inside the working environment (استخدام Rules / Skills / MCP ضمن بيئة العمل)
Skill: manage keys and environment variables securely (إدارة المفاتيح ومتغيرات البيئة بطريقة آمنة)
Training method: project-based applied training — each trainee works on their own project idea during the course, with gradual output review and blocker resolution (تدريب تطبيقي قائم على المشروع)
nodes.rationale: Blockers are resolved 'أولًا بأول' (as they arise) so no trainee falls behind the staged track.

nodes.label: Session element: explain the core concept — simplified presentation of the concept, why it matters and where it sits in the product-building journey (شرح المفهوم الأساسي)
Session element: practical steps — turn the concept into clear, executable steps with measurable outputs (الخطوات العملية)
Session element: live application with the trainer — watch a real execution on a training model with the decisions and results explained (تطبيق مباشر مع المدرب)
Session element: trainee work — apply the steps to their own projects using Claude + Claude Code (عمل المتدربين)
Session element: review and blocker resolution — inspect outputs, handle problems and improve the way of working (المراجعة وحل العوائق)
Session element: templates and FAQs — applied examples and suggested prompt formulas that help repeat the methodology after the course (نماذج وأسئلة شائعة)
nodes.rationale: Explicit aim: the methodology must be repeatable by the trainee after the course ends, not only inside it.

nodes.label: Day split: 45 minutes concept explanation (شرح المفاهيم — 45 دقيقة)
Day split: 60 minutes live application with the trainer (تطبيق مباشر مع المدرب — 60 دقيقة)
Day split: 105 minutes trainees working on their projects (عمل المتدربين على المشاريع — 105 دقيقة) — the largest block of the 240-minute day
nodes.rationale: 45+60+105+30 = 240 minutes = the 4 daily hours; hands-on trainee work gets the largest share, matching the project-based stance.

nodes.label: Day split: 30 minutes review and blocker resolution (المراجعة وحل العوائق — 30 دقيقة)
Trainee package: the 13 files and tools the trainee receives (حزمة المتدرب — الملفات والأدوات التي يحصل عليها المتدرب)
nodes.rationale: Package value stated explicitly: not merely reading material — it contains templates, instructions and checklists that are REUSABLE for building other technical products after the course (قابلة لإعادة الاستخدام).

nodes.label: Package item 01: roadmap and full training curriculum file (ملف خارطة الطريق والمنهج التدريبي الكامل)
Package item 02: project workflow and execution rules file for working with Claude (ملف قواعد سير وتنفيذ المشروع باستخدام Claude)
Package item 03: system-requirements writing standards file (ملف معايير كتابة متطلبات النظام)
Package item 04: template for writing requirements in EARS syntax (قالب لكتابة المتطلبات بصيغة EARS)
Package item 05: user-story and acceptance-criteria templates (قوالب قصص المستخدم ومعايير القبول)
Package item 06: CLAUDE.md file for project memory and instructions (ملف CLAUDE.md الخاص بذاكرة المشروع وتعليماته)
Package item 07: user-journey and workflow-diagram templates (قوالب رحلة المستخدم ومخططات سير العمل)
Package item 08: draw.io skill for producing diagrams (مهارة draw.io لإعداد المخططات)
Package item 09: ERD data-model templates (قوالب نموذج البيانات ERD)
Package item 10: extra rules for Arabic support and RTL direction, when needed (قواعد إضافية لدعم العربية واتجاه RTL عند الحاجة)
Package item 11: sample prompts and instructions used with Claude at every stage (نماذج للأوامر والتعليمات المستخدمة مع Claude في كل مرحلة)
Package item 12: review checklists for product testing, security and permissions (قوائم مراجعة لاختبار المنتج والأمان والصلاحيات)
Package item 13: guide to deploying the product and connecting it to GitHub / Supabase / Vercel (دليل نشر المنتج وربطه بمنصات GitHub / Supabase / Vercel)
Expected output 01: a usable product (منتج قابل للاستخدام)
Expected output 02: integrated documentation and design (توثيق وتصميم متكامل)
Expected output 03: a live link for demoing (رابط فعلي للعرض)

End-of-course outcome: every trainee owns an MVP including screens, database, login and permissions, plus documented requirements, user journey and data model, saved on GitHub and deployed to a live link (من الفكرة إلى منتج فعلي)
Technical requirement: a laptop suitable for development and a stable internet connection (جهاز حاسب محمول مناسب للتطوير واتصال إنترنت مستقر)
Technical requirement: a Claude account that supports using Claude Code (حساب Claude يدعم استخدام Claude Code)
Technical requirement: platform accounts — GitHub / Supabase / Vercel (حسابات المنصات)
Technical requirement: an active email address for creating and activating the accounts (بريد إلكتروني فعّال لإنشاء الحسابات وتفعيلها)
Technical requirement: a display screen and suitable training equipment inside the room (شاشة عرض وتجهيزات تدريبية مناسبة داخل القاعة)
Platform: GitHub — project storage, version and release management
Platform: Supabase — named only in the deployment guide and the required platform accounts, never in the stage list (database/backend platform of the default stack)
nodes.rationale: AMBIGUOUS in the brochure: Supabase appears in the tooling/accounts lists but the build stages only say 'قاعدة البيانات' generically, so the brochure does not formally mandate it as the database.

nodes.label: Platform: Vercel — deployment target for the live demo link
Absence: the brochure defines no grading scheme, evaluation weights, or scored assessment — progress is gated by reviewed stage deliverables instead
nodes.rationale: Flagged because a bootcamp spec would normally carry evaluation weights; here the only quantified allocations are the 45/60/105/30-minute day split and the 12 stage gates.

hyperedges.label: The stage-gate loop: each of the 12 build stages produces a deliverable that the trainee reviews in the daily 30-minute review block before the next stage starts
The mandated platform triad — GitHub for versioning, Supabase for data/backend accounts, Vercel for the live demo link — required as accounts and covered by the package deployment guide
The requirements toolchain: standards file + EARS template + user-story/acceptance-criteria templates all serve stage 4 (متطلبات النظام)
